biomarkers.name: CD68, CD163, lysozyme, CD4 (some)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Confirms histiocytic differentiation; distinguishes from carcinoma, sarcoma, lymphoma

biomarkers.name: CD1a, langerin, S100 (weak or negative)
biomarkers.prevalence: CD1a and langerin negative; S100 variable, often negative or weak/focal
biomarkers.clinical_use: Distinguishes from LCH and dendritic cell sarcomas

biomarkers.name: B-cell / T-cell clonality assessment (IGH-TCR rearrangement)
biomarkers.prevalence: Can be positive in cases arising by transdifferentiation from lymphoid neoplasms
biomarkers.clinical_use: Same clone as prior follicular lymphoma or CLL supports transdifferentiated origin

biomarkers.name: BRAF V600E and other MAPK pathway alterations
biomarkers.clinical_use: MAPK-pathway targeted therapy may be considered when identified

biomarkers.name: PD-L1
biomarkers.clinical_use: Anti-PD-1 responses reported in case reports

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Large pleomorphic cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and histiocytic differentiation by IHC
variants: transdifferentiated from lymphoid neoplasm (follicular lymphoma, CLL — same clonal IGH/TCR rearrangement may be demonstrated depending on antecedent neoplasm)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: MAPK pathway alterations in a subset may enable targeted therapy; PD-L1 expression and anti-PD-1 responses have been reported anecdotally
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Large pleomorphic histiocytic infiltrate; may be localized or widely disseminated at diagnosis

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Mature tissue histiocytes; some cases arise from lineage switching / transdifferentiation of lymphoid neoplasm (follicular lymphoma, CLL) — same clonal origin
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Large pleomorphic histiocytic differentiation (CD68+, CD163+, lysozyme+) with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm; CD1a-negative, S100 variable
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Transdifferentiation from lymphoid neoplasm (follicular lymphoma, CLL) is documented — shared clonal immunoglobulin/T-cell receptor rearrangements may be demonstrable depending on antecedent neoplasm — represents extreme lineage plasticity from lymphoid to myeloid histiocytic phenotype; MAPK pathway alterations in subset enable targeted therapy
